programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 5: Otoci Pašman i Ugljan
Sailing Fever In Annapolis
programme.desc: Welcome to Annapolis!Maryland’s capital city and located on Chesapeake, its historic district includes houses from the 18th century. Besides its historical interest, the city is one of the most exciting places to go to in the United States for nautical sports as yearly hundreds of enthusiasts come here for recreational or competitive races and regattas. Host Lucia Metzbauer heads to the Chesapeake Bay to discover what makes it one of the USA's top sailing destinations. Be part of an exciting regatta, visit the prestigious Yacht Club, meet the locals to enjoy steam crabs and work on your balance with Yoga on a Paddleboard – so many different things going on in this charming seaport. Join Lucia for a journey into American maritime history and an exclusive look at the famous 2014 Annapolis Spring Sailboat Show.

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona - Salón Internacional Barcelona - Ep3
programme.desc: We invite you to discover and remember the best moments in "A day at the Barcelona International Boat Show".During the 4 days of the exhibition, you can discover more than 275 international exhibitors and almost 700 boats on the water, and many more boats at the show.

programme.title: Ocean Safari - South Africa - Episode 4
programme.desc: Andi van Zyl is back to Cape Town to meet up with two board riders. Tammy Robarts has just returned from the ISA World Surfing Games where she represented South Africa in stand up Paddleboarding. The winds in Cape Town have picked up and its time to meet with Luke Mc Gillewie, South Africa's top kite surfer.

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 1
programme.desc: As soon as we arrive on the island, we begin to explore Zanzibar starting in the northern part of the country. Nungwi, our chosen location is a common touristic destination and its guests are famously welcoming. Let's begin our journey by visiting the famous sea turtle conservation and protection center. Buckle up for this adventure!

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 2
programme.desc: We begin this day of discoveries with a visit to the most important historical landmarks in Stone Town. For lunch, we head straight on to The Rock: one of Zanzibar's greatest icons. The restaurant was literally built on a rock and can only be reached on foot during the low tide. Then, we will follow Shabed's suggestion and dive into the water to try all the activities available.

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show - Episode 4
programme.desc: On the fourth episode of Maxiboat, we are back to the Monaco Energy Boat Challenge 2021 that gathered boats motored by alternative propulsion like hydrogen, electric motors and solar. Then we remember the best moments of the Super Yacht Cup in Palma. To finish off, we focus on an XXL Italian luxury rib Pirelli 35 and share the first images before the autumn boat shows of the X Power 33C, the first motor boat from the Danish shipyard X Yachts.

programme.title: Garrett McNamara & The Essence Of Big Wave
programme.desc: Garrett ‘GMAC’ McNamara is the American professional big wave surfer and extreme waterman known for breaking the world record for the largest wave ever surfed at Nazaré, Portugal. Surviving monstrous waves at Jaws, riding tsunamis from calving glaciers in Alaska and many more feats that are impossible to even imagine for many.Catch this exclusive half-hour special of Garrett McNamara & The Essence of Big Wave to understand his drive to get into the water despite knowing he’s risking his life. Find out more about his struggles, life-changing decisions, and the injuries that have made him become the legend he is today. From his earliest surfing days in Hawaii to world record success G-Mac tells it all.

Be part of an exciting regatta, visit the prestigious Yacht Club, meet the locals to enjoy steam crabs and work on your balance with Yoga on a Paddleboard – so many different things going on in this charming seaport. Join Lucia for a journey into American maritime history and an exclusive look at the famous 2014 Annapolis Spring Sailboat Show.

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 1
programme.desc: As soon as we arrive on the island, we begin to explore Zanzibar starting in the northern part of the country. Nungwi, our chosen location is a common touristic destination and its guests are famously welcoming. Let's begin our journey by visiting the famous sea turtle conservation and protection center. Buckle up for this adventure!

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 2
programme.desc: We begin this day of discoveries with a visit to the most important historical landmarks in Stone Town. For lunch, we head straight on to The Rock: one of Zanzibar's greatest icons. The restaurant was literally built on a rock and can only be reached on foot during the low tide. Then, we will follow Shabed's suggestion and dive into the water to try all the activities available.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode, we dive into the beauty of Wales: the first and only country to have a hiking trail around it's entire coastline. The Snowdonia National Park is a surfers and stand up paddlers paradise for the few who know about it. Stunning seascapes, ancient castles and perfect surf waves. This week on Facing Waves we're Paddling Wales with Dan and Heleen from Big Blue Adventures.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 2
programme.desc: With 1000 miles of coastline and 250 miles of world class beaches, to many people the Dominican Republic is known as a tropical paradise. Pounding surf, ideal beaches and warm raging water. This week on Facing Waves, we're paddling the Dominican Republic. Luke Hopkins takes his stand up paddleboard on an exploratory journey along the coast, through the rivers, and in the surf that surrounds this idyllic scenery. Come join us!

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 6
programme.desc: Welcome to What SUP! On this week's episode we have the proclaimed Canadian singer-songwriter Royal Wood. This band has been nominated for their Juno song as songwriter of the year by iTunes in 2008, and his music has been featured in shows slike Greys Anatomy or Private Practice. But, singing won't save them from our paddleboard challenges, is he ready?

programme.title: Posh Port - Madeira
programme.desc: In this episode, host Andi van Zyl gets an inside look at the eco-friendly Quinta do Lorde of Portugal's Madeira island. We will interview the Marina Manager at this dazzling destination and Andi will explore the marina and surrounding coastline. Then, she will learn how to cook a delicious traditional platter and even go sailing taking a dive with dolphins!

programme.title: A Day At DIBS
programme.desc: Dubai International Boat Show, the most trusted and established marine industry exhibition in the Middle East. Despite misconceptions claiming luxury yachts to be the main attraction in this event, the DIBS offer a much wider variety of expositions on nautical news, sports and lifestyle. It differs from other shows as it has a more exclusive clientele and many professionals of this world are yearning to come.You will adventure into one of Dubai’s most prestigious shows featuring the latest releases of yachts and boats from both local and international builders together with the innovations in marine equipment and accessories.Discover all its secret gems with Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 5
programme.desc: Welcome to Sail-ho Croatia! In this episode, we will be taking a look at the Dalmatian hinterland and visit the Croatian royal town of Knin. It has the second largest fortification in Europe and an outstanding nature that surrounds it. We will then explore the island of Vir, one of Croatia's fastest growing islands, and get pumped up with a great offer of activities. Stay with us!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 6
programme.desc: In this episode we're taking you to the capital city of Croatia - Zagreb. Even though it is at more than 100 kilometres away from the sea, it is still considered the main city of charter business in Croatia. Why is this the case? Stay tuned on Nautical Channel to find out more!

programme.title: Chef On Board - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode Chef Lapo Magni and his Captain sail to Elba Island, he will meet with a top Chef from the restaurant Il Chiasso. It is all about the simplicity of Italian Cuisine and combining one or two local ingredients to create a truly unique flavour. Lapo will be up for the ultimate judgement when he opens a temporary kitchen on board and invites guests to critique his island inspired meal.

programme.title: Flavours of Venice - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode, Andi takes us on a journey around the streets of Venice, the sinking city. We will discover unique stores that are sank underwater and learn more about the history and elements of the famous gondola. Then, we will be visiting the Ristorante Riviera by the hand of the Chef Cremonini and asking him to join us onboard to enjoy a delicious meal. Come join us!

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: First stop for this episode is the exotic destination and kiteboarding playground of Mauritius, for one of the most high-profile and biggest kite-foiling events: the Hydrofoil Pro Tour. From one island to another, we leave the exotic racetracks of Mauritius and head to Cagliari on Sardinia for another exciting gathering of the world's best kitefoiling riders. The World Championship also marked the close of the 2017 Kitefoil Gold Cup World Series.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: In this episode, we move to Dongshan, China for the 2017 Dongshan China International Kiteboarding Open. Combining culture with heritage, this small island, located along the Taiwan Strait, hosts a population of 200,000. The Youth Olympic Games is a hot topic in the Kiteboarding community, eagerly anticipated by riders and supporters. Reflecting an exciting and new race format, the slalom/boarder-cross is designed to challenge the riders' ability to stay in control, while maintaining maximum speed.

Barcolana 50
programme.desc: For all sea and sailing lovers and those who would never miss this one-of-a-kind show, the place is always the same every year: Trieste. Founded in 1969 thanks to the initiative of the yacht club Società Velica di Barcola e Grignano, the Barcolana competition has won its worldwide renown.This year’s 50th edition will be packed with surprises: more than 400 offshore and onshore activities, the opportunity to admire the vessel Nave Vespucci, the Barcolana 50 special postage stamp, and the Frecce Tricolori airshow just a few minutes before the start of the race. Stunningly huge yachts and sailboats steered by sailing enthusiasts will compete in the Regatta to mark this special edition of Barcolana 50.Follow this year’s competition of Barcolana 50: the international regatta that has won the Guinness World Record for the greatest sailing race.

programme.title: Iballa - Corazón de Escamas
programme.desc: After more than two decades in the world class of sports and overcoming different personal and sporting challenges of great significance, Iballa Ruano Moreno achieved in 2018 an historical landmark unprecedented in professional sports: winning the world championships in the same year the PWA World Circuit of Windsurf and the APP World Tour of Stand Up Paddle. This milestone never before achieved by an active athlete, highlights the level of dedication and improvement that the Moreno Twins and specifically Iballa Ruano, have been successfully reaping for so many years. However, the journey wasn’t easy. Corazón de Escamas is a short biographical documentary told in the first person and that shows the most intimate part of its history and is dedicated with great affection to the Ruano Moreno family. Dive into the world of this Canarian athlete and find out her inspiring story.

programme.title: World Rowing Beach Sprint - Episode 1
programme.desc: This relatively new exciting format in Coastal Rowing held its first edition of the World Rowing Beach Sprint Finals in Shenzhen, China in 2019. Athletes raced in four boat classes: the mixed double sculls (CMix2x), mixed coxed quadruple sculls (CMix4x+) and men’s and women’s solo (CM1x & CW1x).Watch the best moments of the 2019 edition.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 3
programme.desc: The fourth largest island nation in the Caribbean, Jamaica is a tropicla paradise known worldwide for beautiful beaches, jerk chicken and for being the place where reggae was created. Even though the surfing scene here is surprisingly small and undeveloped, surfers are passionate as any. This week on Facing Waves we will be paddling Jamaica with Ken Whiting.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 4
programme.desc: 190 miles of paddling route. The Great Calusa Blueway Paddling Trail makes its way through the coastal water and inland tributaries of Lee Country in Florida. It is home to a wide range of marine life and birds, and it offers a unique experience for all types of paddlers. Luke Hopkins and Anne Pagano will explore one of the world’s great water trails by stand up paddle board in this week's episode of Facing Waves.

This milestone never before achieved by an active athlete, highlights the level of dedication and improvement that the Moreno Twins and specifically Iballa Ruano, have been successfully reaping for so many years. However, the journey wasn’t easy. Corazón de Escamas is a short biographical documentary told in the first person and that shows the most intimate part of its history and is dedicated with great affection to the Ruano Moreno family. Dive into the world of this Canarian athlete and find out her inspiring story.

programme.title: SFT Surf Foil World Tour - Magazine Ep1
Barcolana 50
programme.desc: For all sea and sailing lovers and those who would never miss this one-of-a-kind show, the place is always the same every year: Trieste. Founded in 1969 thanks to the initiative of the yacht club Società Velica di Barcola e Grignano, the Barcolana competition has won its worldwide renown.This year’s 50th edition will be packed with surprises: more than 400 offshore and onshore activities, the opportunity to admire the vessel Nave Vespucci, the Barcolana 50 special postage stamp, and the Frecce Tricolori airshow just a few minutes before the start of the race. Stunningly huge yachts and sailboats steered by sailing enthusiasts will compete in the Regatta to mark this special edition of Barcolana 50.Follow this year’s competition of Barcolana 50: the international regatta that has won the Guinness World Record for the greatest sailing race.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 3
programme.desc: The fourth largest island nation in the Caribbean, Jamaica is a tropicla paradise known worldwide for beautiful beaches, jerk chicken and for being the place where reggae was created. Even though the surfing scene here is surprisingly small and undeveloped, surfers are passionate as any. This week on Facing Waves we will be paddling Jamaica with Ken Whiting.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 4
programme.desc: 190 miles of paddling route. The Great Calusa Blueway Paddling Trail makes its way through the coastal water and inland tributaries of Lee Country in Florida. It is home to a wide range of marine life and birds, and it offers a unique experience for all types of paddlers. Luke Hopkins and Anne Pagano will explore one of the world’s great water trails by stand up paddle board in this week's episode of Facing Waves.

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 6
programme.desc: Welcome to What SUP! On this week's episode we have the proclaimed Canadian singer-songwriter Royal Wood. This band has been nominated for their Juno song as songwriter of the year by iTunes in 2008, and his music has been featured in shows slike Greys Anatomy or Private Practice. But, singing won't save them from our paddleboard challenges, is he ready?

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 1
programme.desc: As soon as we arrive on the island, we begin to explore Zanzibar starting in the northern part of the country. Nungwi, our chosen location is a common touristic destination and its guests are famously welcoming. Let's begin our journey by visiting the famous sea turtle conservation and protection center. Buckle up for this adventure!

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 2
programme.desc: We begin this day of discoveries with a visit to the most important historical landmarks in Stone Town. For lunch, we head straight on to The Rock: one of Zanzibar's greatest icons. The restaurant was literally built on a rock and can only be reached on foot during the low tide. Then, we will follow Shabed's suggestion and dive into the water to try all the activities available.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Episode 3 - GP of Vietnam - Binh Dinh
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - Season Review - Ski Division & Ski Ladies
Wind Masters - Episode 5: Otoci Pašman i Ugljan
Sailing Fever In Annapolis
programme.desc: Welcome to Annapolis!Maryland’s capital city and located on Chesapeake, its historic district includes houses from the 18th century. Besides its historical interest, the city is one of the most exciting places to go to in the United States for nautical sports as yearly hundreds of enthusiasts come here for recreational or competitive races and regattas. Host Lucia Metzbauer heads to the Chesapeake Bay to discover what makes it one of the USA's top sailing destinations. Be part of an exciting regatta, visit the prestigious Yacht Club, meet the locals to enjoy steam crabs and work on your balance with Yoga on a Paddleboard – so many different things going on in this charming seaport. Join Lucia for a journey into American maritime history and an exclusive look at the famous 2014 Annapolis Spring Sailboat Show.

programme.title: GKA Kite World Tour Summaries - Episode 1
Vilanculos Downwind
programme.desc: We are in Mozambique, the southern African paradise with the long Indian Ocean coastline to its side. Mozambique is not only filled with popular beaches and offshore marine parks, but also incredible windsurfing spots. On this occasion, we celebrate Vilanculos Downwind, a never before done 20 kilometer kitesurf race from the mainland of Mozambique to Bazaruto Island.Join the windsurfers that will journey in the tricky Indian Ocean and race to reach the island of Bazaruto. Departing from the city of Vilanculos, they head for a journey downwind like no other. Don’t miss this once-in-a-lifetime experience, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: Together we’ll travel across the globe and follow the hottest action from the field of Kite! In this Episode, we have the opportunity to witnessup and coming young guns from 4 continents, fighting for their chance to live the Olympic Dream! Dakhla, in Morocco hosts the qualifying event for Europe and Africa, while Pranburi, Thailand is the place where riders from Asia and Oceania will fight for their right to compete in Argentina!

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we are going to take you into the action from the 2018 milestone event, the International Kiteboarding Association, TT:R Youth Worlds. The fastest young athletes from across the globe have gathered on China’s tropical Hainan Island. With 8 qualification spots available for this year’s Youth Olympic Games in Argentina, expect the competition to be fierce!

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 3
programme.desc: Welcome to Amsterdam, one of the most secure cities in the world at the heart of Europe. We are here to discover the Mets: the first European fair for sailing accessories. We will be exploring all the options at the Mets that has set a strong importance to research, and keywords here involve recycling, circular economy and strong environmental awareness.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 4
programme.desc: In this episode we try out the Beneteau Swift Trawler 47, before getting aboard the ZL Elle 14, a boat created by Raffaele Zammarano that shows its own style. Then, we explore the brand Mylius that has evolved into a big shipyard and has great plans for the future. We interview Luciano Gandini, one of the owners of the company, to know a bit more about its history.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 5
programme.desc: Welcome to Sail-ho Croatia! In this episode, we will be taking a look at the Dalmatian hinterland and visit the Croatian royal town of Knin. It has the second largest fortification in Europe and an outstanding nature that surrounds it. We will then explore the island of Vir, one of Croatia's fastest growing islands, and get pumped up with a great offer of activities. Stay with us!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 6
programme.desc: In this episode we're taking you to the capital city of Croatia - Zagreb. Even though it is at more than 100 kilometres away from the sea, it is still considered the main city of charter business in Croatia. Why is this the case? Stay tuned on Nautical Channel to find out more!

programme.title: P1 USA AquaX - Episode 2 - Michigan City
Maya Gabeira - Return to Nazaré
programme.desc: After a horrible crash in Nazaré that almost took her life, big wave surfer Maya Gabeira fights to overcome physical and mental obstacles and return to surf the giant waves again.Maya Gabeira, the Brazilian surfer that was close to death in 2013 in Nazaré due to big waves. She had to be rescued by lifeguards who struggled to get her out of waves that didn’t stop coming. After recovering physically and emotionally of the shock, she's ready to return to Nazaré to overcome the same obstacles that almost took her life years ago.Her determination is undeniable, as is the danger of tempting fate twice. However, once in Nazaré, will she have the strength needed to surf deathly waves?Follow her inspiring story in Maya Gabeira – Return to Nazaré.

But, singing won't save them from our paddleboard challenges, is he ready?

programme.title: SFT Surf Foil World Tour - Magazine Ep1
Barcolana 50
programme.desc: For all sea and sailing lovers and those who would never miss this one-of-a-kind show, the place is always the same every year: Trieste. Founded in 1969 thanks to the initiative of the yacht club Società Velica di Barcola e Grignano, the Barcolana competition has won its worldwide renown.This year’s 50th edition will be packed with surprises: more than 400 offshore and onshore activities, the opportunity to admire the vessel Nave Vespucci, the Barcolana 50 special postage stamp, and the Frecce Tricolori airshow just a few minutes before the start of the race. Stunningly huge yachts and sailboats steered by sailing enthusiasts will compete in the Regatta to mark this special edition of Barcolana 50.Follow this year’s competition of Barcolana 50: the international regatta that has won the Guinness World Record for the greatest sailing race.

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 1
programme.desc: As soon as we arrive on the island, we begin to explore Zanzibar starting in the northern part of the country. Nungwi, our chosen location is a common touristic destination and its guests are famously welcoming. Let's begin our journey by visiting the famous sea turtle conservation and protection center. Buckle up for this adventure!

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 2
programme.desc: We begin this day of discoveries with a visit to the most important historical landmarks in Stone Town. For lunch, we head straight on to The Rock: one of Zanzibar's greatest icons. The restaurant was literally built on a rock and can only be reached on foot during the low tide. Then, we will follow Shabed's suggestion and dive into the water to try all the activities available.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: Together we’ll travel across the globe and follow the hottest action from the field of Kite! In this Episode, we have the opportunity to witnessup and coming young guns from 4 continents, fighting for their chance to live the Olympic Dream! Dakhla, in Morocco hosts the qualifying event for Europe and Africa, while Pranburi, Thailand is the place where riders from Asia and Oceania will fight for their right to compete in Argentina!

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we are going to take you into the action from the 2018 milestone event, the International Kiteboarding Association, TT:R Youth Worlds. The fastest young athletes from across the globe have gathered on China’s tropical Hainan Island. With 8 qualification spots available for this year’s Youth Olympic Games in Argentina, expect the competition to be fierce!

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 5: Otoci Pašman i Ugljan
Sailing Fever In Annapolis
programme.desc: Welcome to Annapolis!Maryland’s capital city and located on Chesapeake, its historic district includes houses from the 18th century. Besides its historical interest, the city is one of the most exciting places to go to in the United States for nautical sports as yearly hundreds of enthusiasts come here for recreational or competitive races and regattas. Host Lucia Metzbauer heads to the Chesapeake Bay to discover what makes it one of the USA's top sailing destinations. Be part of an exciting regatta, visit the prestigious Yacht Club, meet the locals to enjoy steam crabs and work on your balance with Yoga on a Paddleboard – so many different things going on in this charming seaport. Join Lucia for a journey into American maritime history and an exclusive look at the famous 2014 Annapolis Spring Sailboat Show.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 3
programme.desc: The fourth largest island nation in the Caribbean, Jamaica is a tropicla paradise known worldwide for beautiful beaches, jerk chicken and for being the place where reggae was created. Even though the surfing scene here is surprisingly small and undeveloped, surfers are passionate as any. This week on Facing Waves we will be paddling Jamaica with Ken Whiting.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 4
programme.desc: 190 miles of paddling route. The Great Calusa Blueway Paddling Trail makes its way through the coastal water and inland tributaries of Lee Country in Florida. It is home to a wide range of marine life and birds, and it offers a unique experience for all types of paddlers. Luke Hopkins and Anne Pagano will explore one of the world’s great water trails by stand up paddle board in this week's episode of Facing Waves.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 5
programme.desc: Welcome to Sail-ho Croatia! In this episode, we will be taking a look at the Dalmatian hinterland and visit the Croatian royal town of Knin. It has the second largest fortification in Europe and an outstanding nature that surrounds it. We will then explore the island of Vir, one of Croatia's fastest growing islands, and get pumped up with a great offer of activities. Stay with us!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 6
programme.desc: In this episode we're taking you to the capital city of Croatia - Zagreb. Even though it is at more than 100 kilometres away from the sea, it is still considered the main city of charter business in Croatia. Why is this the case? Stay tuned on Nautical Channel to find out more!

programme.title: Iballa - Corazón de Escamas
programme.desc: After more than two decades in the world class of sports and overcoming different personal and sporting challenges of great significance, Iballa Ruano Moreno achieved in 2018 an historical landmark unprecedented in professional sports: winning the world championships in the same year the PWA World Circuit of Windsurf and the APP World Tour of Stand Up Paddle. This milestone never before achieved by an active athlete, highlights the level of dedication and improvement that the Moreno Twins and specifically Iballa Ruano, have been successfully reaping for so many years. However, the journey wasn’t easy. Corazón de Escamas is a short biographical documentary told in the first person and that shows the most intimate part of its history and is dedicated with great affection to the Ruano Moreno family. Dive into the world of this Canarian athlete and find out her inspiring story.

Wild Surf - Episode 4
programme.desc: This week on Wild Surf the legendary surfer Garrett McNamara will glide in the water in Portugal, the place he is actually at now. We will learn more about this surfer that seems to be one with water to understand better his connection to the ocean and nature. Are you coming with us?

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 7
programme.desc: On episode seven of What SUP we have stand up and sketch comedian Stephanie Tolev. She was recently awarded 2015 Female Canadian Comedian of the year, and has performed at the prestigious Just For Laughs Comedy Festival across the country. We are ready to head down to the water with her and have some laughs, care to join in?

programme.title: Mr. Price Pro Ballito
programme.desc: Follow the world leaders of surfing as they come to South Africa, Willard beach Ballito. 96 competitors from 18 countries will surf for the 250,000$ prize. Also, music concerts filled with South African bands will be cheering the best surfers of the world with their jamming.

programme.title: PaddleSUP Mission Amazon
programme.desc: Charlie Head will attempt the first ever stand-up paddle boarding of the main water source of the Amazon, the Rio Marañón in Peru. It’s never been attempted before and will be the most arduous and longest SUP journey ever made.Two months of using just his physical and mental strength, Charlie will overcome extreme terrain, trek around impassable river rock falls, survive freezing waters, high altitude, swarms of insects and suspicious local tribes.However, all the hardships will be worth it if he can help shine some light on one of the planet’s most endangered environments and educates us on conservation as over 20 new dams are planned to be constructed on the river's free-flowing stretches. This could have, according to scientists, drastic consequences on the Amazon basin forever.If Charlie does not embark on this adventure now, he may never be able to do so. Find out more with Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Join us on a journey through one of the most welcoming island of the Caribbean, Guadeloupe! Explore its natural habitats rich in colour and rhythmic sounds that hypnotize us in this dreamy destination.Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe takes us on a journey in the world of art as we meet a local artist whose art shines light on our modern habits. Discover this hub for scuba divers as you swim through Cousteau's underwater reserve, a breath-taking spot for all those who love diving into the clear blue waters of the Caribbean.Finally, come dance to the drumbeats of a Caribbean jam whilst allowing the contagious energy to move you. Not many islands lend themselves as well as Guadeloupe! Be sure not to miss our exciting excavation through this unforgettable island on the Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Journey To Giglio
programme.desc: On January of 2012 the Italian cruise ship Costa Concordia sank in shallow waters after striking an underwater rock off Isola del Giglio. Many things remained unclear about this tragedy, so Andi van Zyl is set to discover the truth regarding this incident.Journey to Giglio is an investigative piece on the infamous Costa Concordia tragedy. Andi van Zyl is on the Italian island of Giglio for an exclusive exposé on the shipwreck that shocked the world. She will leave no rock unturned as she digs into what happened the night of the accident and uncovers the disaster’s impact on the local residents and economy.Highlights include exploration of the island and disaster site, and an interview with the man at the helm of the salvage operation, Nick Sloane. Andi sits down with the fellow South African to discuss the delicate process of freeing the wrecked cruise-liner from the reef without spoiling the pristine waters of Giglio Island.Find out the mystery behind the sinking of Costa Concordia on this Journey to Giglio.

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 7
programme.desc: Our journey starts this time with the wrapping up of the following 44Cup, a well-established series that is highly regarded in the sailing industry. Among the teams and sailors it attracts, Team Aqua and Peninsula Petroleum are the most loyal ones on the tour.Our next stop takes us to the leading kitefoiler, Florian Gruber who will explain how the COVID-19 virus has affected his daily routine. He would normally spend his time flying around the globe competing in the world's top events, however this is not the current reality. The final stop for this episode includes the top ten moments of GC32 Racing Tour.

programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 3
programme.desc: Out of the fray and sitting pretty after winning the Round Robin qualifiers, Oracle Team USA now waits for the winner. Following the script, France says goodbye while the fabulous four New Zealand, Sweden, Great Britain and Japan take on the Louis Vuitton Challenger Playoffs. We will talk with weather guru inside the role of America's Cup meteorologists and close up at the heart of Artemis Racing, the Swedish Challenger.

programme.title: Les Voiles De St Barth - Episode 1
programme.desc: Marking the end of the Mediterranean yachting season, Les Voiles de Saint Tropez will be back for its 20th edition. Close to 4,000 sailors and more than 300 sailing yachts will gather in St Tropez in early autumn for an action-packed programme of competitive racing and lively social events.

Buckle up for this adventure!

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 2
programme.desc: We begin this day of discoveries with a visit to the most important historical landmarks in Stone Town. For lunch, we head straight on to The Rock: one of Zanzibar's greatest icons. The restaurant was literally built on a rock and can only be reached on foot during the low tide. Then, we will follow Shabed's suggestion and dive into the water to try all the activities available.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 4
programme.desc: 190 miles of paddling route. The Great Calusa Blueway Paddling Trail makes its way through the coastal water and inland tributaries of Lee Country in Florida. Luke Hopkins and Anne Pagano will explore one of the world’s great water trails by stand up paddle board in this week's episode of Facing Waves.

programme.title: Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Join us on a journey through one of the most welcoming island of the Caribbean, Guadeloupe! Explore its natural habitats rich in colour and rhythmic sounds that hypnotize us in this dreamy destination.Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe takes us on a journey in the world of art as we meet a local artist whose art shines light on our modern habits. Discover this hub for scuba divers as you swim through Cousteau's underwater reserve, a breath-taking spot for all those who love diving into the clear blue waters of the Caribbean.Finally, come dance to the drumbeats of a Caribbean jam whilst allowing the contagious energy to move you. Not many islands lend themselves as well as Guadeloupe! Be sure not to miss our exciting excavation through this unforgettable island on the Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Journey To Giglio
programme.desc: On January of 2012 the Italian cruise ship Costa Concordia sank in shallow waters after striking an underwater rock off Isola del Giglio. Many things remained unclear about this tragedy, so Andi van Zyl is set to discover the truth regarding this incident.Journey to Giglio is an investigative piece on the infamous Costa Concordia tragedy. Andi van Zyl is on the Italian island of Giglio for an exclusive exposé on the shipwreck that shocked the world. She will leave no rock unturned as she digs into what happened the night of the accident and uncovers the disaster’s impact on the local residents and economy.Highlights include exploration of the island and disaster site, and an interview with the man at the helm of the salvage operation, Nick Sloane. Andi sits down with the fellow South African to discuss the delicate process of freeing the wrecked cruise-liner from the reef without spoiling the pristine waters of Giglio Island.Find out the mystery behind the sinking of Costa Concordia on this Journey to Giglio.

programme.title: Monaco Yacht Show - 2013

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 7
programme.desc: Welcome sailors! The island of Krk is the largest island in the Adriatic Sea and today's destination. We are going to pay a short visit to the island of Rab where we'll jump into traditional dances and try out some of the local produce. Find out this beautiful location on Sail-Ho Croatia!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 8
programme.desc: In today's episode of Sail-Ho we're taking you to two very interesting islands. Cres and Losinj were originally a single island, but to make sailing easier they were separated with a man made channel. Then we will investigate why roasted lamb from Cres is so delicious before exploring intriguing secrets of the sandy island of Susak.

programme.title: Chef On Board - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode Lapo arrives in Capraia, a beautiful island in the Tuscan Archipelago. Rich with volcanic soil Capraia produces some excellent wines, and harvests some unique plants that make rich flavours. Lapo will discover the island with a world champion spier fisherman who uses sustainable fishing methods to serve at his five star restaurant. Will he impress the hardest critiques when they sample his dish or will he fail to impress? As usual he is still trying to win over his Captain.

programme.title: Flavours of Venice - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this second episode of Flavours of Venice, Andi will be learning the art of the gondola, visiting one of the most beautiful displays of art and getting a taste of the lagoon. She will not only be in the city with cicchetti, but also on board with Dimitri Gris. Join her on this new adventure of Flavours of Venice, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Mr. Price Pro Ballito
programme.desc: Follow the world leaders of surfing as they come to South Africa, Willard beach Ballito. 96 competitors from 18 countries will surf for the 250,000$ prize. Also, music concerts filled with South African bands will be cheering the best surfers of the world with their jamming.

programme.title: Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Join us on a journey through one of the most welcoming island of the Caribbean, Guadeloupe! Explore its natural habitats rich in colour and rhythmic sounds that hypnotize us in this dreamy destination.Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe takes us on a journey in the world of art as we meet a local artist whose art shines light on our modern habits. Discover this hub for scuba divers as you swim through Cousteau's underwater reserve, a breath-taking spot for all those who love diving into the clear blue waters of the Caribbean.Finally, come dance to the drumbeats of a Caribbean jam whilst allowing the contagious energy to move you. Not many islands lend themselves as well as Guadeloupe! Be sure not to miss our exciting excavation through this unforgettable island on the Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Journey To Giglio
programme.desc: On January of 2012 the Italian cruise ship Costa Concordia sank in shallow waters after striking an underwater rock off Isola del Giglio. Many things remained unclear about this tragedy, so Andi van Zyl is set to discover the truth regarding this incident.Journey to Giglio is an investigative piece on the infamous Costa Concordia tragedy. Andi van Zyl is on the Italian island of Giglio for an exclusive exposé on the shipwreck that shocked the world. She will leave no rock unturned as she digs into what happened the night of the accident and uncovers the disaster’s impact on the local residents and economy.Highlights include exploration of the island and disaster site, and an interview with the man at the helm of the salvage operation, Nick Sloane. Andi sits down with the fellow South African to discuss the delicate process of freeing the wrecked cruise-liner from the reef without spoiling the pristine waters of Giglio Island.Find out the mystery behind the sinking of Costa Concordia on this Journey to Giglio.

programme.title: Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec
programme.desc: Rowing through icy currents in the cold is not for the faint of heart. However, every year competitors jump into their canoes to race in the Ice Canoe Carnival Quebec. The Canoe Race is a legendary competition that has been held since the Carnival's first edition. When the Québec Winter Carnival returned in 1955, ice canoe racing became once again an important annual event, and is now awaited by many in the Canadian city.Each year, several courageous teams compete in extremely freezing conditions a tumultuous ride along the St. Lawrence River between Quebec City and Levis. Find out which team will win against the cold and icy Canadian conditions!

programme.title: World Rowing Coastal Championship - Episode 1
programme.desc: Competition has docked in Vancouver for the 2019 World Rowing Coastal Championship. An endurance test like no other, the event has buoy turns usually with a minimum distance of 4000m. With the stunning background of Vancouver Island, the World Champion of seven different boat classes will be crowned in this final.Watch the best moments of the 2019 competition of the World Rowing Coastal Championship.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 5
programme.desc: Stretching 360 miles along the Pacific Ocean, the Oregon coast is well known for it's beautiful towns and dramatic shorelines. The coast itself is divided into three unique regions called the North Coast, Central Coast and South Coast. It has earned the name of the wild river's coast, and combined, it is an outdoor adventure travellers paradise with endless opportunities. Get onboard as we discover the Oregon Coast paddling with the waves.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 6
programme.desc: Located between Sweden's second largest city, Gothenburg and the Norwegian border archipelago of the Swedish west coast invites us to explore some of its 8000 islands. We'll also take our time to emerge in downtown city paddling and canoeing on a 150 year old aquaduct in Bohuslän. Facing Waves host, Ulrika Larsson, reveals her favourite paddling waters along the rugged granite coast in West Sweden during all four seasons.

Andi sits down with the fellow South African to discuss the delicate process of freeing the wrecked cruise-liner from the reef without spoiling the pristine waters of Giglio Island.Find out the mystery behind the sinking of Costa Concordia on this Journey to Giglio.

programme.title: South to Sian
programme.desc: In a time where there are fences around everything, and we are denied the instinct of self-preservation, it is difficult to find a place free from rules and restrictions, but not yet impossible.Surf movies come and go, a million waves in exotic locations and surfers flown in for three-day shoots on perfect swells, but the spirit of adventure never dies.What began as a three-month trip to a collection of surf breaks off the beaten track turned into a two-year odyssey of exploration, injury, companionship and 4,000km of two-wheeled, single-finned escape from the the real-world burdens of modern life.Harrison Roach and Zye Norris pack their bags, a diverse quiver of boards, two bikes and a 50-dollar tent into a 1970s Land Rover and embark on an epic quest from the southern reaches of Bali, through the Indonesian archipelago to Northern Sumatra’s isolated Lagundri Bay. On boards, on bikes, by boat and four-wheel drive, the pair’s journey is to discover if, in these days of GPS and WiFi, the dream of a true pioneering surf adventure is still alive.

programme.title: Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Join us on a journey through one of the most welcoming island of the Caribbean, Guadeloupe! Explore its natural habitats rich in colour and rhythmic sounds that hypnotize us in this dreamy destination.Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe takes us on a journey in the world of art as we meet a local artist whose art shines light on our modern habits. Discover this hub for scuba divers as you swim through Cousteau's underwater reserve, a breath-taking spot for all those who love diving into the clear blue waters of the Caribbean.Finally, come dance to the drumbeats of a Caribbean jam whilst allowing the contagious energy to move you. Not many islands lend themselves as well as Guadeloupe! Be sure not to miss our exciting excavation through this unforgettable island on the Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Journey To Giglio

programme.title: Stockholm Archipelago Raid
programme.desc: The Stockholm Archipelago Raid is for participants a unique orienteering race in Europe as it offers a mix of sport, nature and adventure to athletes. This archipelago is the largest in Europe, with 36,000 rocks, skerries and islands, as well as one of the most difficult for navigation. There are still islands and groups of islands where no sail race has ever passed due to their remote location or because they are bird or seal protection areas.Experienced sailors from all over the world gather in the heart of Sweden as it hosts the first F18 Raid World ever. Winners will be crowned as the best long distance F18 raid sailors in the world, marking history in this nautical sport.Watch the Stockholm Archipelago Raid on Nautical Channel and discover the limitless possibilities of this Raid for brave competitors that will race in these remote islands.

programme.desc: Moana Waiwai follows the Free Swim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she takes on 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline to bring awareness to the protection of New Zealand’s oceans.For over three days it does more than encapsulate stunning panoramas on the extraordinary scenario of New Zealand. It is also inspiring for people as we become aware of the natural beauty of the ocean so we can protect it before it is too late.This is an inspirational film, not an activist propaganda, that highlights exploration and the intrinsic benefits of getting wet and looking below the surface. In Moana Waiwai Ally Davey will champion endurance of her human spirit in this seemingly impossible task to achieve a higher goal: protection of the oceans.Be part of her adventure on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Perilous Sea
programme.desc: Perilous Sea is a transcontinental cold-water surfing odyssey capturing the raw spirit, glorious landscapes and pure perfection that arises when conditions align. This incredible story creates moments of cold-water nirvana that rival any across the globe.Inspired by the storytelling style of classic ocean-fairing novels, Perilous Sea follows a group of surfers as they explore the landscapes and waves of the North Atlantic fringes. From the Canadian Maritimes, north to Iceland and beyond to the wave rich coast of Ireland, this award-winning film takes us on a journey to the world of surf.Follow them into the water as they dare to get into the treacherous waters that have taken the lives of many in Perilous Sea: a story of overcoming challenges and spirituality.

programme.title: Discovering Symi
programme.desc: Welcome to the beautiful island of Symi, Greece, in the middle of the Aegean Sea. Symi is part of the Dodecanese island chain, located about forty-one kilometres northwest of Rhodes, featuring fifty-eight-point one square kilometres of mountainous terrain.In this series we will discover the beauty of Symi’s capital, Gialos, and its neighbouring district of Chorio as we learn more about the hospitable harbour of the island, a popular resting place for sailors to park up and explore.Symi is home to a long tradition of shipbuilding, handmade boats with real charm. Get to know first-hand this handiwork before visiting the historic castle and taking a ride on a traditional Grecian boat. You will see this apparently small island is filled with a vast variety of things to do, see and eat.Join us on Nautical Channel on our journey to the Aegean Sea to discover the secrets of Symi.

programme.title: OFQUI
programme.desc: The Isthmus of Ofqui, unknown for many and chosen as surf destination by few adventurers.The stretch of land that separates the Pacific Ocean's inland seas, is the only way to make it if you want to surf the shores of Golfo de Penas. Connecting the Taitao Peninsula with the Chilean mainland, Ofqui offers world class waves. This thaw surf film approaches the vast territory of the Patagonia in different ways, this time, centered around Ofqui.Pro surfers will face ice-cold waters in their expedition to surf deathly waves in Ofqui, one of the most unknown locations of the Patagonia and with a microclimate that maximises the upcoming waves.Join them in their adventure to Ofqui here, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 9
programme.desc: In this episode we have arrived to Istria, a part of the Croatian coast considered by many as the real hedonist paradise. We will visit the antic city of Pula, with its beautiful Roman colosseum and the medieval town of Labin. Also, we'll introduce you to Rovinj, the most romantic town in Croatia.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 10
programme.desc: Istria is often called the Queen of Gastronomy, and to explore how much of that is true, we visited some of the top restaurants of the region. Then we explored the beautiful places near the Lim Channel - Funtana, Porec and Vrsar. Stay tuned on Sail-Ho Croatia!

programme.title: Chef On Board - Episode 3
programme.desc: Lapo and his Captain are sailing to Pianosa, a very remote and exclusive Island. As it is a prison island, boats cannot come within a mile radius. This means Lapo is on a solo mission. Lapo will meet the prisoners who are keeping the island pristine but taking care of it’s natural fauna and flora. He will cook with ingredients from the prison garden and learn a secret dish from one of the wardens. Will this impress the Captain?

programme.title: Flavours of Venice - Episode 3
programme.desc: We have approached the end of the series, and in this final episode Andi will be experiencing the art of glass blowing on the island of Murano. Then, she will enjoy a vegan meal prepared on board that has been paired with coffee instead of wine. Let's dive into the flavours of Venice!

programme.title: The Kayak Man
programme.desc: Another expedition? You must be crazy.This is what Beppe's friend told him when he decided to leave for North America. Even after paddling in the biggest rivers in the world, his desire for adventure was still not satisfied, and he went out looking for more. Dreaming of freedom, sleeping bags and nature, he ventured into the unknown to discover the Yukon and Teslin Rivers.For those unaware, the Yukon river is the major watercourse of the northwest of North America. It flows through the Canadian Yukon Territory and makes it's way to Alaska. The Teslin River is a bit shorter, but not for this reason less fun to dive into. They both offer an impressive scenery amidst cold temperatures, dangerous whitewaters and the wild nature of North America.The Kayak Man takes us on a journey of self discovery through the most beautiful landscapes of Canada and the United States while following the path of a brave kayaker that leaves his life behind in an attempt to explore new horizons by himself. An impressive trip that will not leave him the same way he was before.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 1
programme.desc: Three times the size of Texas and the largest province in Canada, Quebec is a big place. It's also blessed with 3% of the world's freshwater, more than half a million lakes and has the enormous St. Lawrence River flowing through its interior, which empties the Great Lakes into the Atlantic Ocean. Breathtaking coastlines, crystal clear rivers and pristine wilderness lakes. This week on facing waves, we're exploring the regions of Gaspesie and Bas-Saint-Laurent.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 2

programme.title: GKA Kite World Tour Summaries - Episode 3
3 Days
programme.desc: Telegram: SkarlavaIn June 2015 something that changed the history of surfing took place in Nias. For three epic days on the 28th, 29th and 30th some of the heaviest barrels on the planet exploded onto the Indonesian reef. This has resulted in 3 days of surfing madness in Nias, Indonesia as the bravest world surfers dive into the water to battle and catch some of the biggest waves.Featuring world known surfers Luke Dillon, Dave Rastovich, Courtney Conlogue, Anthony Walsh, Damien Healey, Matt Bronley, Justin Bu'ulolo, Alex Bu'ulolo, Jim Burgin, Antoni Dachi, Skeet Durham, Philips, Matt Younis, Rodrigo Sino Leonardo Kessa and more...Don’t miss out on 3 days of pumping waves and heavy barrels that will mesmerise you on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: In this episode we’ll continue to follow the action of the 2018 KiteFoil World Series. We’ll reveal the new World Champions crowned in Cagliari, Italy at the final event of the series, the 2018 Sardinia Kiteboard Grand Slam.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: As kiteboarding becomes more popular and accessible to the masses, the hopes of many turn towards the Olympic Games. Although shaken, the spirit of the kiteboarders and their steadfast refusal to be defeated is rewarded with a vote of inclusion for the Youth Games in 2018 for the very first time. Yet again the Olympic dreams of the kiteboarders are on the line as the sport comes up for consideration for the Tokyo Games 2020.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 7
programme.desc: The evolution on boats has been massive, as yachts are complex products that need to be easy to maneuver, preferably from one command point. Today we will be taking a look at the Simrad On Board FY 670 controller before getting the latest from Black Water's new brand 43 SF. Finally, we try out the Joker Boat Clubman 24 on The Boat Show.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 8
programme.desc: Hello and welcome to The Boat Show. Today we're in Genoa, Italy, on a very hot and sticky day at the Tankoa shipyard for the launch of its latest superyacht 72-meter Solo. Then, we move on to the Italian boat maker Absolute who has premiered the 62 Fly recently. Let's get on board!

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: As kiteboarding becomes more popular and accessible to the masses, the hopes of many turn towards the Olympic Games. Although shaken, the spirit of the kiteboarders and their steadfast refusal to be defeated is rewarded with a vote of inclusion for the Youth Games in 2018 for the very first time. Yet again the Olympic dreams of the kiteboarders are on the line as the sport comes up for consideration for the Tokyo Games 2020.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 1
programme.desc: Three times the size of Texas and the largest province in Canada, Quebec is a big place. It's also blessed with 3% of the world's freshwater, more than half a million lakes and has the enormous St. Lawrence River flowing through its interior, which empties the Great Lakes into the Atlantic Ocean. Breathtaking coastlines, crystal clear rivers and pristine wilderness lakes. This week on facing waves, we're exploring the regions of Gaspesie and Bas-Saint-Laurent.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 2
programme.desc: One of the most remote regions of Quebec is the Cote-Nord. A wild and wonderful place filled with new discoveries, like paddling with puffins and through rocks carbed by time. With more than 20,000 lakes and rivers and endless pristine wilderness, the region is an outdoor lover's paradise and dream destination for paddlers. This week on Facing Waves we're visiting Quebec's Cote-Nord and Abitibi-Temiscamingue.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 9
programme.desc: In this episode we have arrived to Istria, a part of the Croatian coast considered by many as the real hedonist paradise. We will visit the antic city of Pula, with its beautiful Roman colosseum and the medieval town of Labin. Also, we'll introduce you to Rovinj, the most romantic town in Croatia.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 10
programme.desc: Istria is often called the Queen of Gastronomy, and to explore how much of that is true, we visited some of the top restaurants of the region. Then we explored the beautiful places near the Lim Channel - Funtana, Porec and Vrsar. Stay tuned on Sail-Ho Croatia!

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Ep.2 - Season Preview
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP of Indonesia (Runabout & Freestyle)
What Sup - Episode 8
programme.desc: On this week's episode of What SUP we have comedian Dom Pare and the powerful rock band 20Amp. Dom is one of Chris' favourite comedians in Canada, and he is sure his quick wit and unconventional charm will win you over. We are taking him for some laughs on our paddle. Come watch along!

programme.title: Perilous Sea
programme.desc: Perilous Sea is a transcontinental cold-water surfing odyssey capturing the raw spirit, glorious landscapes and pure perfection that arises when conditions align. This incredible story creates moments of cold-water nirvana that rival any across the globe.Inspired by the storytelling style of classic ocean-fairing novels, Perilous Sea follows a group of surfers as they explore the landscapes and waves of the North Atlantic fringes. From the Canadian Maritimes, north to Iceland and beyond to the wave rich coast of Ireland, this award-winning film takes us on a journey to the world of surf.Follow them into the water as they dare to get into the treacherous waters that have taken the lives of many in Perilous Sea: a story of overcoming challenges and spirituality.

programme.title: Qatar Airways GKA Kite World Tour Magazines - Episode 1
Atlantic Cup - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the Atlantic Cup presented by 11th Hour Racing. Teams of two on a 40-foot race boat gather to race the East Coast of the United States. They will battle the elements and themselves for the right to call themselves Atlantic Cup champions. We will recap on the previous editions action before embarking on this new adventure. Are you ready?

programme.title: Inside Superyachts - Episode 2
programme.desc: From the Godfather of builders to the Grandaddy of designers we visit the studio of Bannenberg & Rowell to unveil the legend that is the late great Jon Bannenberg. Following the winds of change we discuss the growing demand for explorer yachts. We meet London based H2 Design, and learn about the groundbreaking 107m explorer M/Y Ulysses.We continue our theme with EYOS Explorer and DAMEN yachts, the largest and most prolific ship builder on the planet.

programme.desc: In this episode we’ll continue to follow the action of the 2018 KiteFoil World Series. We’ll reveal the new World Champions crowned in Cagliari, Italy at the final event of the series, the 2018 Sardinia Kiteboard Grand Slam.

Yet again the Olympic dreams of the kiteboarders are on the line as the sport comes up for consideration for the Tokyo Games 2020.

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 7: Rab, Crikvenica and Novi Vinodolski
Moana Waiwai
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai follows the Free Swim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she takes on 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline to bring awareness to the protection of New Zealand’s oceans.For over three days it does more than encapsulate stunning panoramas on the extraordinary scenario of New Zealand. It is also inspiring for people as we become aware of the natural beauty of the ocean so we can protect it before it is too late.This is an inspirational film, not an activist propaganda, that highlights exploration and the intrinsic benefits of getting wet and looking below the surface. In Moana Waiwai Ally Davey will champion endurance of her human spirit in this seemingly impossible task to achieve a higher goal: protection of the oceans.Be part of her adventure on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Ride to the Roots - Jonathan Paredes
A Date with the Strait
programme.desc: The Bass Strait is a strip of water that divides the Australian mainland from Tasmania. Knowing that wild storms make the strait twice as rough as the English Channel, sailors stand in awe of the strong currents.In a death-defying act, two Aussies and a young Californian kneeling on their boards brave the 300 km/186.5mi paddle across the Bass Strait. Their adventure lasts several days with stops on small islands along the way. Apart from sharks, currents and threatening waves, win-or-bust Zeb Walsh, Brad Gaul and Jack Bark face sickness, sore muscles and dehydration. Follow their journey on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 9
programme.desc: In this month’s episode our first stop will be Marseille, for the 2020 L30 EUROSAF European Champion Title. After that we will change continent and we’ll head to Korea where the 2020 Southern Coast Cup International Yacht Competition was co-hosted by three cities and provinces.Later, we will move to Greece in order to follow the 57th International Aegean Sailing Rally, a regatta with a long history, organized every year by the Hellenic Offshore Racing Club. While in the crystal-clear Aegean waters, we’ll head to Thessaloniki for a very competitive event. Many of the best yachts from Greece participated at the National Championships of Offshore Sailing.

programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 4
programme.desc: Emirates Team New Zealand follows the script and gets the pass to take on the Defender for the 35th America's Cup Match. 100% fly-time, 40 knot match races, close scalls, close contact, a helmsmen going overboard... we will take an in depth look at safety in a modern day America's Cup. Then on exclusive: Franck Cammas encounters a rudder blade and we dive into the body gear for the AC50 crews with Thierry Fouchier.

programme.title: Atlantic Cup - Episode 2
programme.desc: The second leg of the race goes from New York City to New Port City, Rhode Island. There are two major challenges on this leg: one is getting out of New York Harbour, dealing with the tides and the thicker winds that come off the city, and the other is dealing with the commercial traffic, as it is one of the busiest ports in the world. How will the skippers manage?

Breathtaking coastlines, crystal clear rivers and pristine wilderness lakes. This week on facing waves, we're exploring the regions of Gaspesie and Bas-Saint-Laurent.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 2
programme.desc: One of the most remote regions of Quebec is the Cote-Nord. A wild and wonderful place filled with new discoveries, like paddling with puffins and through rocks carbed by time. With more than 20,000 lakes and rivers and endless pristine wilderness, the region is an outdoor lover's paradise and dream destination for paddlers. This week on Facing Waves we're visiting Quebec's Cote-Nord and Abitibi-Temiscamingue.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 9
programme.desc: In this episode we have arrived to Istria, a part of the Croatian coast considered by many as the real hedonist paradise. We will visit the antic city of Pula, with its beautiful Roman colosseum and the medieval town of Labin. Also, we'll introduce you to Rovinj, the most romantic town in Croatia.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 10
programme.desc: Istria is often called the Queen of Gastronomy, and to explore how much of that is true, we visited some of the top restaurants of the region. Then we explored the beautiful places near the Lim Channel - Funtana, Porec and Vrsar. Stay tuned on Sail-Ho Croatia!

programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 4
programme.desc: Emirates Team New Zealand follows the script and gets the pass to take on the Defender for the 35th America's Cup Match. 100% fly-time, 40 knot match races, close scalls, close contact, a helmsmen going overboard... we will take an in depth look at safety in a modern day America's Cup. Then on exclusive: Franck Cammas encounters a rudder blade and we dive into the body gear for the AC50 crews with Thierry Fouchier.

programme.title: Atlantic Cup - Episode 2
programme.desc: The second leg of the race goes from New York City to New Port City, Rhode Island. There are two major challenges on this leg: one is getting out of New York Harbour, dealing with the tides and the thicker winds that come off the city, and the other is dealing with the commercial traffic, as it is one of the busiest ports in the world. How will the skippers manage?

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 8: Senj, Cres, Losinj
Kieler Woche 2014
programme.desc: Celebrate with us the 132nd anniversary of the legendary Kieler Woche. With over 4000 regatta participans, this is the biggest sailing event in the world, and more than 50 nations participate in exciting races across the waters off the coast of Kiel's Schilksee. More than three million visitors from all over the world will be diving into the colorful and multi-faceted life of Kieler Woche. Get ready to discover the highlights of this unique event in this particular show!

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona - Salón Internacional Barcelona - Ep6
One with Water
programme.desc: We are connected to the ocean, and if the ocean is not okay, we are not okay. This is the philosophy of free diving record holder Hanli Prinsloo. From a young age, she has been aware of the importance animals and nature have on us, so she has been going underwater to explore her body.Prinsloo is going to take us on a literal breath-taking journey underwater. She believes it is easier to hold our breath than what it is commonly believed, and the underwater world takes us on a new journey of wilderness undiscovered for many. Get ready to dive with her and US Olympic swimmer Peter Marshal in One with Water, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts - Episode 3
programme.desc: Speed is the name of the game in this episode as we visit Dutch shipyard Heesen Yachts, renowned builder of record breaking, fast, lightweight aluminium superyachts. We talk to naval architects ‘Omega’ and we get an onboard look at the racing colour design of M/Y Aurelia, designed by Bannenberg & Rowell. Finally, no yacht would be complete without the latest technology and fastest onboard gadgets. We discover just what’s hot on a yacht with the most sought-after tech and AV firm, IdeaWorks.

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show - Episode 7
programme.desc: In this new episode of Maxiboat we travel to the Cannes Yachting Festival 2021 for a special show. We jump on board the new Beneteau Gran Trawler 62, discover the Outremer 55 sailing catamaran, the new 2022 outboards and notably the incredible V12 from the American Mercury. Also at the Yachting Festival, we will dive into the most beautiful new motorboats and yachts of the show: Riva 68 Diable, Azimut Grande Trideck, Azimut 53, Azimut 68, the Swan Shadow and the Med Yacht 42.

programme.title: Ride to the Roots - Jonathan Paredes
Discovering Watersports On Terceira
programme.desc: Terceira, on the Azores Islands, is a nautical sporting paradise for many. From pro surfers to passionate sailors, we dive into the lives of local athletes that are fortunate to call this island home.Discovering Watersports On Terceira joins athletes from different categories on their nautical challenges on their way to excellence. However, it also centers on the human aspect, checking on secret spots used by these water enthusiasts as well as lifestyle in the Azores Islands.Join us in their adventure, here on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Meet me in Madeira
programme.desc: Welcome to Madeira!The main island of the volcanic Portuguese archipelago is home to a wide sea life and rich ecosystem. With its subtropical climate, Madeira is a chosen destination for nautical sports enthusiasts that enjoy the paradisiac conditions of the island.From diving to surfing, sailing to coasteering, Madeira offers a wide variety of nautical activities for the avid sportsmen or just the visiting tourist. Join Andi van Zyl on an experience that only this Portuguese archipelago has to offer, from stand-up paddling to wine tasting.Discover the secrets of Madeira and get to know the heart-warming locals of the beautiful archipelago in an exclusive show on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 1
programme.desc: Hello sailors! Welcome to this new season of Sail-ho Croatia. We're starting this season in a city that will surely take your breath away: Dubrovnik. We will be exploring interesting places in search of the legacy left by the old captains of the Dubrovnik republic. But first, we visit the island of Lokrum just a few hundred meters from the Old Town.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 2
programme.desc: We have arrived to an island that will challenge all your senses; colours, sounds, smells and tastes are all a little bit more intense over here. We are talking about the island of Korčula, an unmissable destination for many yachtsmen. The island is abundant in lush nature, and we are eager to discover more. Come join us!

programme.title: Chef On Board - Episode 4
programme.desc: Lapo arrives on Giglio Island where he meets a local fisherman who supplies the restaurants with their seafood. On their trip out to sea, Lapo learns about species of the area and how to fish sustainably. He finds his catch when a bunch of girls who come from America come to dine on board. Now, its the right time to remember everything he learnt from the Maestros.

programme.title: Ciuri Ciuri
programme.desc: Sicily, the largest Mediterranean island and just off the “toe” of Italy’s “boot” is the destination chosen this time by our Nautical Hosts Andi and Chelsey as they head to the South of Italy to meet up with renowned Sicilian sailors.Its rich history is not only reflected in their cuisine and culture, but also on their sailing techniques that balance tradition with modern skills. They will discover the coastlines near Palermo to learn how to tack and jibe and of course will try the delicious Sicilian cuisine.Join Andi and Chelsey on their journey around Sicily learning about sailing and tasting traditional dishes in Ciuri Ciuri, exclusive on Nautical Channel.

We are talking about the island of Korčula, an unmissable destination for many yachtsmen. The island is abundant in lush nature, and we are eager to discover more. Come join us!

programme.title: Bass By Kayak
programme.desc: Bass by Kayak follows a small expedition party formed by four adventurers crossing from the Australian mainland to Tasmania in sea kayaks. With a 300 km separation, a bare four hundred people have made the crossing of the Bass Strait in the modern era. Before then, Aboriginal Australians sailed in their canoes the shocking distance during the last ice age.This adventure makes strategic stops on the islands along the way; however, it is one of the toughest and deadliest journeys in the world. Adventure filmmaker Beau Miles narrates the expedition as the first ever feature film of the crossing via sea kayaks.The travellers will experience chafe, storms, bad cooking and an emerging mate-ship between men that barely know each other.Watch it now with Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 3
programme.desc: Connecting North America's Great Lakes with the Atlantic Ocean, the Saint Lawrence is one of the largest and most important waterways in the world. It's also home to some of the most diverse and inspiring landscapes, like Les Iles de la Madeleine, a breathtaking chain of islands with endless sand beaches, spectacular sea caves and a charming small town vibe. This week on Facing Waves, we're visiting Quebec City and Les Iles de la Madeleine.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 4
programme.desc: What makes Canada's largest provinces so great is how big and rugged the landscape is. This means there are endless opportunities for outdoor adventure. Less than an hour from the cities of Montreal and Ottawa, the Laurentians is one of the most accessible regions of Quebec and one of the top adventure spots in the country. This week we will discover the Laurentians and Authentic Quebec.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 2 World Cup Duisburg
programme.desc: Welcome to Duisburg in Germany! The World Cup 2 of the 2018 season is being disputed, and athletes from all over the world are pitching themselves in one of the most beautiful settings we have on the circuit. Kayaks, canoes, singles, doubles and fours... all are fighting to go to the Olympic Games in Tokyo in two years time. Let's see where they are at the moment! Discover the best action of the weekend's regatta in Duisburg.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 3 World Cup Montemor
programme.desc: In this third stage of the competition we are in Montemor-o-Velho, in Portugal. This is the 2018 ICF Sprint World Championships, where 676 athletes from 66 nations are ready to give everything they have and raise with the title. The weather is perfect and the organization is perfect. Will the athletes be up to standards in this awaited event? Let's look back at the best of the action over the past four days of competition.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: In this episode we’ll continue to follow the action of the 2018 KiteFoil World Series. We’ll reveal the new World Champions crowned in Cagliari, Italy at the final event of the series, the 2018 Sardinia Kiteboard Grand Slam.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: As kiteboarding becomes more popular and accessible to the masses, the hopes of many turn towards the Olympic Games. Although shaken, the spirit of the kiteboarders and their steadfast refusal to be defeated is rewarded with a vote of inclusion for the Youth Games in 2018 for the very first time. Yet again the Olympic dreams of the kiteboarders are on the line as the sport comes up for consideration for the Tokyo Games 2020.

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 9
programme.desc: This is the final episode of the season and we want to end with a big finale. This is why we have comedian Mike Rita on tonight's episode. He has quickly branded himself as one of Canada's top comedic performers, and his writing can be heard on Vice TV. Let's hit the water with Mike!

programme.desc: Celebrate with us the 132nd anniversary of the legendary Kieler Woche. programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 4
programme.desc: Emirates Team New Zealand follows the script and gets the pass to take on the Defender for the 35th America's Cup Match. 100% fly-time, 40 knot match races, close scalls, close contact, a helmsmen going overboard... we will take an in depth look at safety in a modern day America's Cup. How will the skippers manage?

programme.title: Cape Verdean Kite Crossing
programme.desc: Mitu Monteiro, a Cape Verdean kitesurfer and multi-time world champion, attempts the solo crossing of the twelve volcanic islands of his native archipelago, never accomplished before.Taking on more than 730km of kitesurfing, interspersed with island traverses by only man-powered means totalling approximately 200km, Mitu’s challenges lay ahead of him. With a total trajectory of nearly 1,000km and a route that had to be thought and rethought due to wind direction, shark infested waters, and distances that push this athlete to his limit, sweat will flow and his nerves will surely be put to the test.Mitu’s maverick journey across marvellous Atlantic waters and beaches, through inhospitable lunar landscapes and the lush vegetation of the volcanic islands is truly a SURFARI on a kite. Relive the whole experience on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode, we are in the TwinTip open Worlds in Hangloose beach, Italy where Florian Gruber has defended his title for the 3rd time! Then, we are set to join the Kite World Series in China’s Weifang and Pingtan where the fastest foilers are ready to set new records in kite foiling. We finish our journey at the final of the series that took place in Cagliari, Italy where Maxim Nocher has been crowned Champion of the series.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we will focus on the action around the 2019 Kite Foil World Series, which is composed by four non-discard events. This means that all the event scores will be counted. The series began in Gizzeria, Italy and will head to China’s Pingtan and Weifang in September for two successive, action packed events before concluding in Cagliari, Italy. With the latter being the place where the male and female of 2019 Kite Foil World Champions will be crowned.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 9
programme.desc: We are here in Viareggio getting ready for an out-of-the-norm and important event. The Varo Benetti FB 803 is the latest unit in the Benetti 800 family, and we are ready to discover it. Then, we try out the 40 Open Sunreef Power, a very fast catamaran with a wonderful platform for sun tanning before boarding the Absolute Navetta 68.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 10
programme.desc: Today we will project into the future to the newly presented engine, the Yamaha XTO Offshore V8 425. Then, we get on board the Agilis 330, built by Agilis Jet Tender, a company headquartered in Germany. Finally we travel to Castellammare di Stabia, not far away from Naples to try out the dinghy 27 GT built by MV Marine shipyards but also the engine Honda BF with a 250 horsepower.
